description_en: Updates the bindng relationship between an audit callback and a business scenario (BizType). Valid values of BizType can be obtained by calling the DescribeUserBizTypes operation. Valid values of Name can be obtained by calling the DescribeAuditCallbackList operation
description_zh: 更新审核回调（Audit Callback）与业务场景（BizType）的绑定关系；BizType 有效值通过 DescribeUserBizTypes 获取，Name 有效值通过 DescribeAuditCallbackList 获取
kebab_example: aliyun green update-callback-bind --biz-type default --name test_callback --api-version 2017-08-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCallbackBind

parameters.help_en: The business scenario. Valid BizType values must be obtained by calling the DescribeUserBizTypes operation. The DescribeBizTypes operation returns system-predefined types rather than user-defined BizType values
parameters.help_zh: 业务场景。有效 BizType 值需通过 DescribeUserBizTypes API 获取，并且 DescribeBizTypes 返回的是系统预定义类型而非用户自定义 BizType
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The callback name. Only audit callback names are accepted. Valid values must be obtained by calling the DescribeAuditCallbackList operation. Regular callback names returned by the DescribeCallbackList operation are not applicable
parameters.help_zh: 回调名称。仅接受审核回调名称，有效值需通过 DescribeAuditCallbackList API 获取，DescribeCallbackList 返回的常规回调名称不适用
parameters.name: name
